items.title: Paddles for a Purpose
items.summary: Students and supporters joined together for Paddles for a Purpose!
items.story: Paddles for a Purpose was OttoTHON's first-ever pickleball tournament. Held in a round-robin style competition accompanied by a fun-filled raffle generously donated by our sponsors, we were proud to raise $2,089 in support of Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital!

items.title: Interactive Playground Opening
items.story: Our Executive Director, Caroline Antolick, had the opportunity to attend the opening of Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital interactive playground, a space designed to make play accessible and inclusive for ALL kids. We’re so grateful to see our community continuing to create spaces where every child can play, connect, and have fun.

items.title: Ignite Leadership Conference
items.story:
This past weekend, OttoTHON's Steering Team had the opportunity to attend the Ignite Leadership Conference in Indianapolis! A conference where leaders from Dance Marathon programs across the country, attend recruitment and fundraising workshops, and learn how to improve their leadership and communication skills. OttoTHON Steering also met with Children's Miracle Network advisors, program managers, and leadership to discuss our plans and ideas for OttoTHON 2027. With the highlight of their weekend being the opportunity to meet four of CMN’s National Champions, who were incredibly well-spoken, kind, and inspirational kids!

OttoTHON's Executive Director, Caroline Antolick, said "Personally, I learned a lot of valuable lessons on effective leadership. As Executive Director, I believe strongly in the importance of integrity, accountability, and transparency, both for myself and this year’s Executive Board. People will not trust you if you don’t give them a reason to do so, and this past weekend, I was able to absorb new strategies to earn that trust. I attended a President’s and Director’s Summit, where we discussed the importance and value of leaning on the strengths of others around us. OttoTHON unites people with different backgrounds, talents, and abilities for an extremely important cause, and this year’s Steering Team and I will lead with authenticity and understanding." 

On Saturday, they concluded their experience at Ignite by attending the Event Showcase, where they saw Morale Dances from programs all over the country, cheered on the Champion Kids in a talent show, and raised an incredible $16,728.50 for Children’s Miracle Network hospitals in just ONE HOUR! 

Overall, OttoTHON's Steering Team found Ignite to be an incredibly valuable learning experience. Our Steering Team, along with the entire organization, is deeply grateful for the opportunity to represent OttoTHON and Syracuse University among such a passionate, kind, and dedicated community of student leaders—not only throughout this past weekend, but every day as we continue to grow and make an impact together.
